title: Uniform acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: The answer must state the acceleration during the initial uniformly accelerated motion as 3 m/s².

title: Maximum speed value
description: Essential: The answer must correctly calculate the final maximum speed of the car as 13.5 m/s.

title: Total displacement
description: Essential: The answer must state the total displacement from rest to maximum speed as 67.5 m.

title: Force balance during acceleration
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law to find the net force during the initial acceleration phase.

title: Power-velocity relationship
description: Important: The solution must correctly use the relationship P = Fv at maximum speed to find the constant driving force.

title: Kinematic phase analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly separate and analyze the two phases: uniform acceleration and constant power acceleration.

title: Resistance force calculation
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly calculate the total constant resistance force (0.1mg) and the component of weight down the slope.

title: Sign error in slope forces
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign for the gravitational force component along the slope when setting up the force balance.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Failing to convert mass from tons to kg or power from kW to W, leading to incorrect numerical results.
